title: SEC.gov | SEC: Payments for Bullish Articles on Stocks Must Be Disclosed to Investors
关键词: Disclosure of Payments for Bullish Articles
主要内容: The U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) announced enforcement actions against 27 individuals and entities involved in alleged stock promotion schemes. These schemes misled investors by disguising paid promotions as objective and independent analyses. The SEC found that public companies hired promoters or communications firms to generate publicity for their stocks, and these firms subsequently hired writers to publish articles without disclosing the payments from the companies. Over 250 articles included false statements about the writers not being compensated by the companies they were writing about. The SEC emphasized that companies must disclose payments for articles promoting their stocks. The enforcement actions included fraud charges against three public companies, seven stock promotion firms, two CEOs, six individuals at the firms, and nine writers. Of those charged, 17 have agreed to settlements ranging from $2,200 to nearly $3 million. The SEC also issued an investor alert warning about potential fraud on investment research websites and advised investors to thoroughly research companies before making investment decisions. The SEC has issued a directive requiring that any payments made for bullish articles on stocks must be disclosed to investors. This regulation aims to enhance transparency and protect investors from potential conflicts of interest. The directive was announced in a press release dated April 10, 2017, and emphasizes the importance of full disclosure in financial communications.
